title: Northloop Protect Plans Ledger Note: Reversal of Settlements and Refund of Claim Service Fees
content:
**Rule.** Under the Northloop Protect Plans, a paid settlement is reversed only for a reason in the plan's list of settlement reversal reasons. A collected service fee is refunded when the claim is denied and the plan refunds a collected service fee on denial; a fee on a settled claim is never refunded.

On all six plans the settlement reversal reasons are a voided gift card and a duplicate payment, and every plan refunds a collected service fee when the claim is denied.

## Effect on the plan's balances

- **Settlement reversal.** A reversal is recorded against the claim settled, with its reason and the value reversed. The plan's claims paid total is the value of settlements paid net of reversals, so a reversal reduces it by the value reversed.
- **Service fee refund.** A refund is recorded against the claim whose fee was collected. The service fees a buyer has paid on a plan are counted net of service fee refunds.

## Points of judgement

| Item | Fact | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Paid settlement | Reason is a voided gift card | May be reversed |
| Paid settlement | Reason is a duplicate payment | May be reversed |
| Paid settlement | Any other reason | Not reversed |
| Collected service fee | The claim was denied, on a plan that refunds the fee on denial | Refunded |
| Collected service fee | The claim was settled | Never refunded |

## Hypothetical illustrations

- A reimbursement of 300.00 USD was paid by Northloop gift card and the gift card was later voided. A voided gift card is a reversal reason, so the settlement may be reversed; once reversed, the plan's claims paid total falls by 300.00 USD.
- A buyer asks for a settled repair to be reversed because a different repair shop would have been preferred. That is not a reversal reason, so the settlement is not reversed.
- A 49.00 USD service fee was collected on an accidental damage claim that was then denied: the fee is refunded. Had the claim been settled, the 49.00 USD fee would never be refunded.
